tasks: Fix GitHub issues #966, #967, #989, #990 and #991 together: follow-ups from the boundary-lag telemetry branches (wf/940-941-943-boundary-lag-telemetry and wf/fix-github-issues-942-and-944-together-i-176982), which must already be merged into the base you are building on; verify _pending_retry_mode and the dict-partitioned boundary_lag_history exist before starting and halt with a clear note if they do not. (#966) In custom_components/localshift/state/machine.py, _pending_retry_mode is not cleared when a fresh decision token is granted (_apply_decision_token rewrites _last_grant_source but leaves the marker), nor in _handle_automation_disabled (sets _commanded_mode = MANUAL and returns early) nor in set_commanded_mode (manual button press). Clear it in all three so a genuinely fresh price grant after a failed attempt is tagged price, not retry; add tests for each path. (#967) decision_lag_history still records from_mode from data.active_mode, the same dead field #940 fixed in boundary_lag_history; record from_mode from self._commanded_mode.value there too so the two rings agree, and update the decision_lag_history entry docs in custom_components/localshift/coordinator/data.py and docs/ENTITY_REFERENCE.md. (#989) custom_components/localshift/sensors/status.py _flatten_boundary_lag_history's cross-bucket chronological merge is untested (mutation proof: deleting the sort passes the suite); add a test with two buckets carrying real interleaved interval_start_utc values asserting the merged output is chronological and the last-20 window crosses bucket boundaries. (#990) _BOUNDARY_LAG_PER_SOURCE_CAP = 50 silently reversed the documented 200 choice; raise it to 200 per source (about 1800 entries worst case, still trivial) and state in the comment why that size serves #510 slice 3's sample-size need. (#991) tests/test_decision_lag.py fixtures at roughly lines 548 and 572 still construct boundary_lag_history=[] (flat list) after the field became dict[str, list]; they pass only because an empty list is falsy. Change them to {} and add one test that a non-empty dict flows through extra_state_attributes without error. Write failing tests first; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #982: remove the inert adaptive_params plumbing left behind when #962 retired the parameter-learning layer (this is the second half of #962; nothing writes data.adaptive_params any more so every consumer reads the empty default). Remove: the AdaptiveParameters dataclass and data.adaptive_params field in custom_components/localshift/coordinator/data.py; _get_solar_confidence_factor(adaptive_params) and the adaptive_params positional argument of build_slots in custom_components/localshift/engine/slots.py (all three call sites); set_adaptive_params and _apply_consumption_bias in custom_components/localshift/forecast/load.py; the set_adaptive_params call in custom_components/localshift/computation_engine.py; the cheap_price_bias = adaptive.get(...) line in custom_components/localshift/engine/optimizer_runner.py; the adaptive_params_at_decision field on DecisionRecord in custom_components/localshift/engine/outcomes.py (keep loading old persisted records that carry the key: ignore it); the adaptive_params_values attribute in custom_components/localshift/sensors/forecast.py if still present; and the OPTIMIZABLE_PARAMS dict, OptimizableParam dataclass, LEARNING_MIN_OBSERVATIONS and LEARNING_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS in custom_components/localshift/const.py. Delete or rewrite the roughly 15 test references across tests/coordinator/test_data.py, tests/forecast/test_load.py and tests/sensors/test_forecast.py. Also resolve GitHub issue #970 in the same change by REMOVAL, consistent with #962: ForecastCorrectionProvider in custom_components/localshift/forecast/corrections.py is wired to nothing (record_error has zero production callers, set_forecast_corrections in forecast/load.py has zero production callers, so _apply_context_correction always returns its input, and custom_components/localshift/learning/telemetry.py loads and saves an always-empty provider under localshift.forecast_corrections.<entry_id> every save cycle). Remove the module, the telemetry store and property, set_forecast_corrections and _apply_context_correction, and tests/forecast/test_corrections.py; keep the day_of_week and season plumbing in forecast/pipeline.py ONLY if the per-day-of-week load profiles from #679 (sibling branch) use it, otherwise remove it too. Run the full suite; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #983: delete unreferenced constants, CONF keys, OptimizerConfig fields and translation strings. In custom_components/localshift/const.py delete BOOST_CHARGE_MAX_SOC, DISCHARGE_EARLIEST_HOUR, MAX_NEGATIVE_FIT_HEADROOM_PCT (and its two references in tests/test_const.py), CONF_TESLEMETRY_SOLAR_ENERGY, CONF_EXPORT_MIN_SPREAD, CONF_SPIKE_PRICE_PERCENTILE and DEFAULT_SPIKE_PRICE_PERCENTILE. For CONF_CHEAP_PRICE_DEADBAND and CONF_FORECAST_LOOKAHEAD_HOURS: they are written into options at setup in custom_components/localshift/config_flow/__init__.py but the engine reads the DEFAULT_* constants directly, so remove the CONF keys, the setup-time writes, and the matching option strings in custom_components/localshift/translations/en.json and strings.json. In custom_components/localshift/engine/types.py remove the never-read fields OptimizerConfig.stale_solar_conservative, OptimizerConfig.stale_solar_confidence_ceiling, OptimizerConfig.self_consumption_value_per_kwh, SlotContext.price_source, PlannedSlotDecision.is_solar_opportunity and PlannerReasonCode.DEMAND_WINDOW_CONSTRAINT, together with the writes that populate them in custom_components/localshift/engine/optimizer_runner.py, engine/slots.py and engine/core.py; before deleting SlotContext.price_source confirm nothing on the #510 slot-0 path reads it (it was added there recently) and keep it if so. Elsewhere delete ACTION_TO_LEGACY_MODE in engine/outcomes.py, MAX_5MIN_FORECAST_HOURS in engine/slot_schedule.py, CONFIDENCE_LOW_THRESHOLD and _pending_observations in learning/correlation.py, PERIODIC_INTERVAL and self._listeners in coordinator/coordinator.py, _loaded in forecast/history_store.py, and _previous_mode in select.py. Each deletion must be verified with a repo-wide grep before it is made; report any symbol you kept and why. Run the full suite; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #980: in custom_components/localshift/computation_engine.py delete the nine one-line delegating wrappers that compute_derived_values no longer calls (it calls the pipeline and price-signal objects directly): _compute_solar_battery_forecast, _compute_load_forecast_slots, _compute_effective_cheap_price_preliminary, _compute_effective_cheap_price, _get_profile_for_day, _scan_forecast_for_spike, _max_forecast_price, _analyze_spike, _compute_excess_solar_signals, together with the tests in tests/test_computation_engine.py that only assert each wrapper forwards to a mock. Delete self._baseline_avg_kw (written once in __init__, never read). Make _read_fresh_soc delegate to BatteryController.read_fresh_soc in custom_components/localshift/integration/controller.py instead of carrying a byte-for-byte copy (or move the helper to custom_components/localshift/state/reader.py and call it from both). Drop the unused entity_id parameter from _get_historical_hourly_averages. Verify every deletion with a repo-wide grep first. Run the full suite; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #979: custom_components/localshift/engine/optimizer_runner.py still carries the pre-facade batch entry point run_optimizer() and its private call chain with no production caller (the live path is OptimizerFacade.run_inline, which imports only the helper functions). Delete run_optimizer, _run, _get_ha_timezone, _map_mode_to_action, _make_cycle_id, _validate_slot_alignment and _compute_legacy_energy_totals, fix the module docstring that claims the coordinator calls run_optimizer, and delete data.daily_forecast in custom_components/localshift/coordinator/data.py (never written, read only by the deleted alignment validation). Drop _build_summary's now-dead alignment parameter and the alignment_valid / alignment_issues / alignment_warnings summary keys, and the reads of those keys in custom_components/localshift/sensors/optimizer.py (they are always the empty defaults on the live path already) plus their doc lines in docs/ENTITY_REFERENCE.md. Move or delete the tests that only exist to exercise run_optimizer: tests/test_optimizer_scaffold.py, tests/test_optimizer_runner_integration.py, the relevant parts of tests/engine/test_optimizer_runner.py and tests/test_optimizer_active_mode.py; where a test in those files pins real behaviour of a surviving helper (for example the misaligned :12/:27/:42/:57 forecast fixtures), keep that coverage by re-pointing it at the facade path rather than deleting it. Confirm with a repo-wide grep that the facade imports are exactly the helpers that remain. Run the full suite; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #981: delete CoordinatorData fields in custom_components/localshift/coordinator/data.py that are never read. Never written and never read (delete outright): proactive_export_active, surplus_ratio, daily_forecast_hourly, daily_forecast_soc_15min, forecast_charging_decisions, charging_needed_before_dw, optimal_charge_start, optimal_charge_end, debug_dry_run, debug_commanded_mode, debug_pending_transition, debug_debounce_wait_seconds, excess_solar_current_kw, hybrid_slot_metadata, optimizer_active_applied_at, should_grid_charge, should_boost, charge_amount_kwh, price_per_kwh. Written every tick but never read (delete the field AND its writer): hybrid_solar_accuracy together with LocalShiftCoordinator._update_hybrid_accuracy in custom_components/localshift/coordinator/coordinator.py and tests/test_hybrid_accuracy.py (ForecastAccuracyComparisonSensor recomputes it independently); optimizer_result and the _serialize_result call in custom_components/localshift/engine/optimizer_facade.py; primary_decision and shadow_decision writes in optimizer_facade.py and custom_components/localshift/state/reader.py (ComparisonResultSensor reads comparison_match only); optimizer_safety_block_reason; physical_response_timestamp in coordinator.py (DecisionLagSensor reads physical_response_lag_seconds); and the spike_end_time, spike_max_price, spike_price_threshold, spike_hours_remaining writes in custom_components/localshift/engine/spike_analyzer.py (only spike_reserve_soc and spike_in_conservative_mode are consumed). Never written but read: preserve_soc is read in integration/controller.py and state/machine.py but is always None so every read collapses to the literal 10; delete the field and simplify the branches to the constant. Verify each with a repo-wide grep before deleting, and be aware sibling branches from the previous run touch data.py (boundary_lag_history, synthetic-slot rate for #956) so leave those fields alone. Add a static test under tests/ that walks CoordinatorData's fields via the AST and fails on any field with no reader outside data.py, allow-listing nothing. Run the full suite; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #984: delete functions and methods with zero production callers that are kept alive only by their own tests, verifying each with a repo-wide grep before deletion. Engine: is_cheap_import_window and is_blind_to_future_solar in custom_components/localshift/engine/constraints.py (reason_codes has the live versions), compute_recoverability_floor_pct in engine/negative_fit.py, get_price_for_slot_with_source in engine/price_calculator.py, OptimizerFacade._floor_suppressed_by_solar in engine/optimizer_facade.py. Forecast: SolarAccuracyTracker._compute_context_bias, _compute_context_additive_bias and the deprecated get_additive_correction stub in custom_components/localshift/forecast/solar_accuracy.py, compute_weighted_confidence in forecast/solcast_analysis.py, ConfidenceResolver.get_analysis_for_period in forecast/analysis_resolver.py, _get_period_estimate in forecast/solar.py. State and coordinator: StateMachine._handle_debounce_timing and _handle_soc_monitoring (always returns False, so the `if await ...: return` branch in _evaluate_core is dead) in custom_components/localshift/state/machine.py, LocalShiftCoordinator._check_entity_health, _handle_periodic_tick and TickScheduler.handle_periodic_tick (marked DEPRECATED, no subscriber) in custom_components/localshift/coordinator/, EntityValidator.reset_broken_status in utils/validation.py, NotificationService.generate_decision_reason and its seven _reason_* helpers in services/notification_service.py, BatteryController._read_str in integration/controller.py. Do NOT delete CostTracker.reset_daily_accumulators: PR #988 (merged 2026-09-06) made the midnight reset delegate to it, so it is live now. Config flow and sensors: LocalShiftConfigFlow._validate_entities, _validate_notify_service and _get_notify_services in config_flow/__init__.py (the steps call the module functions directly), MinimumTargetSOCSensor (sensor.localshift_target_soc_minimum, which mirrors number.localshift_minimum_target_soc; remove its doc entry too), the duplicate re-imports inside sensor.py async_setup_entry, and the duplicated entities/dependencies attribute in EntityHealthSensor in sensors/status.py. Leave engine/optimizer_dp.py (the backward-compatibility shim) alone unless every importer can be repointed in the same change. Delete the tests that only exercise each removed symbol. Report every symbol you kept and why. Run the full suite; keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Fix GitHub issue #986: make the CI dead-code gate able to fire. .github/workflows/lint.yml runs vulture at --min-confidence 80 (reports nothing) and scripts/hybrid_dead_code.py --min-confidence medium || true (static-only without coverage.json, cannot fail). Add a vulture_whitelist.py at the repo root listing the Home Assistant framework names that vulture flags as unused (async_setup_entry, device_info, extra_state_attributes, icon, async_step_*, _attr_* and the rest you find by running vulture at 60 against the current tree after the dead-code deletions on this branch), point [tool.vulture] in pyproject.toml at it, lower --min-confidence to 60 and remove any continue-on-error so it blocks. For hybrid_dead_code.py either have the test job emit coverage.json and pass it in with the || true removed, or delete the script and its workflow step; prefer deletion unless the coverage-aware mode adds findings vulture misses, and say which you chose. Run the new gate locally and make it green against this branch. Also list, in your summary, the 44 test functions that contain no assertion (in particular tests/state/test_state_machine.py test_transition_to_* around lines 803, 823 and 855 assert nothing about the transition) but do not fix them here. Keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.
